sources.title: Tencent Releases and Open-Sources Tencent Hy4 preview
sources.evidence: Dated August 28, 2026; explicitly announces released open weights and availability through Tencent products, TokenHub and OpenRouter.

sources.title: Hy4 preview official model card (pinned)
sources.evidence: Labels 770B total and 49B active as backbone-only counts; separately reports one 10B-total/0.7B-active MTP layer. Documents MoE, Gated DSA, IndexCache, iHC, text generation, optional reasoning and tool parsers; separates original and FP8 variants.

sources.title: Hy4 preview checkpoint configuration (pinned)
sources.evidence: HYV4ForCausalLM, 78 layers, 256 routed and one shared expert, top-8 routing, one MTP layer, 1,048,576 maximum positions, BF16 and untied embeddings; no vision module is configured.

sources.title: Hy4 preview license (pinned)
sources.evidence: Tencent explicitly licenses Hy4 preview under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Hy4 preview chat template (pinned)
sources.evidence: Implements high/no_think modes, with high the default, text serialization, function signatures, assistant tool calls and tool responses.

sources.title: Tencent Cloud ADP introduces Hy4 Preview
sources.evidence: August 28, 2026 announcement says customers can immediately select the model; explicitly defines hosted 1M as 1,024,000 tokens and documents multi-round tools.

sources.title: Hy4 preview checkpoint index (pinned)
sources.evidence: Index maps 2,006 tensors across 131 shards, including backbone, MTP and lm_head entries. Only the index was inspected; shapes, buffers and unique learned-parameter total were not reconciled.

name.note: Exact public model name; preview is retained.

developer.note: Released by Tencent and developed by its Hy team.

family.note: Retains the catalog family label for Tencent Hy; this is the early Hy4 variant.

release_date.note: Explicit public availability announcement, not an upload or listing timestamp.

open_weights.note: Tencent explicitly releases original and separate FP8 weights; this audit uses the original checkpoint.

license.note: Applies to the exact Hy4 preview release.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded language-backbone count, excluding a separately reported 10B MTP layer. Not an exact complete-checkpoint count; header shapes, configured modules, tied tensors and buffers were not fully reconciled.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded active backbone parameters per token. The MTP layer separately has 0.7B active parameters; these represent different decoding phases and are not combined.

architecture.note: 78-layer autoregressive Transformer: one dense FFN then 77 MoE layers, each with 256 routed plus one shared expert and top-8 routing; Gated DSA, IndexCache and iHC; separate native MTP.

context_window.note: Original checkpoint max_position_embeddings is 1,048,576. Tencent ADP describes the hosted service as 1,024,000; these are distinct documented limits, so the model record uses configured checkpoint capacity.

modalities.note: Official text-generation checkpoint and text template; no vision encoder or image/audio input processing is present in the reviewed configuration.

reasoning.note: Default high reasoning mode and optional no_think responses are explicitly supported.

tool_call.note: Official template implements function calls/responses and deployment instructions enable tool-call parsers.

description.value: Tencent Hy preview text-generation MoE model with optional reasoning and tool calling, designed for coding and productivity tasks.
description.note: Replaces unqualified comparative capability wording with documented model type, modes and intended tasks.

patch.description: Tencent Hy preview text-generation MoE model with optional reasoning and tool calling, designed for coding and productivity tasks.
patch.notes: Tencent reports nominal backbone-only counts of 770B total and 49B active parameters. A separate native MTP layer is reported as 10B total and 0.7B active for speculative decoding; no exact complete-checkpoint count or combined active count is claimed. The original BF16 checkpoint is distinct from Hy4 preview-FP8 and has no configured vision module. Its configuration permits 1,048,576 positions; Tencent ADP advertises a hosted 1,024,000-token context. The August 28, 2026 release announcement explicitly establishes public availability.

sources.label: Tencent Releases and Open-Sources Tencent Hy4 preview
Tencent Cloud ADP introduces Hy4 Preview

summary: Confirmed August 28, 2026 public release, open weights, text modalities, optional reasoning and tools. Add Apache-2.0, MoE, nominal 770B/49B backbone counts with separately scoped 10B/0.7B MTP, and configured 1,048,576 context with hosted-limit caveat. Targeted searches for later Hy4 technical reports did not locate a separate first-party report refining these figures. Original checkpoint metadata and current official card were reviewed; complete learned-parameter total remains unverified, and no weight shard or tensor header was downloaded.
